source_corrections.evidence: source-fidelity QA and pinned-schema validation pass; the empty set is bounded below but has no real infimum
source_corrections.source_issue: the completeness-axiom paraphrase says any subset of the reals bounded below has a greatest lower bound but omits nonemptiness
source_corrections.target_action: require the subset to be nonempty

source_corrections.evidence: source-fidelity QA and pinned-schema validation pass; the empty set has no real supremum
source_corrections.source_issue: the least-upper-bound and supremum assertion omits nonemptiness
source_corrections.target_action: require the subset to be nonempty

source_corrections.evidence: source-fidelity QA passes and the adjacent definition supplies the intended relation
source_corrections.source_issue: the summary says a lower bound or a subset instead of for a subset

source_corrections.evidence: protected-math allowance is explicit and the surrounding statement declares only the set S
source_corrections.source_issue: the least-upper-bound condition calls k an upper bound for lowercase s instead of the declared set S
source_corrections.target_action: replace s with S in the derivative formula

source_corrections.evidence: source-fidelity QA and pinned-schema validation pass; the defining infimum is not a real number for an empty distance set
source_corrections.source_issue: the point-to-set distance summary omits that A must be nonempty

source_corrections.evidence: explicit protected-math allowances pass and the displayed supremum separates every distinct pair in X
source_corrections.source_issue: C[a,b] is described as functions from R to R on [a,b], making the displayed supremum rule only a pseudometric when functions differ outside the interval
source_corrections.target_action: define X as continuous functions f:[a,b] to R for a nonempty compact interval a<b

source_corrections.evidence: source-fidelity QA and pinned-schema validation pass; the Archimedean property supplies an integer greater than nx
source_corrections.source_issue: the quoted well-ordering principle omits nonempty and the proof invokes it before establishing the particular integer set S is nonempty
source_corrections.target_action: state the principle for a nonempty integer subset and explicitly establish S is nonempty

source_corrections.evidence: source-fidelity QA and pinned-schema validation pass; empty bounded subsets have no real infimum or supremum
source_corrections.source_issue: the final true-false exercise uses infima and suprema after assuming only that S and T are bounded
source_corrections.target_action: require S and T to be nonempty bounded subsets

source_corrections.evidence: protected-math allowance and pinned-schema validation pass; the chapter definition requires A nonempty
source_corrections.source_issue: the final point-to-set item uses d(x,A) without requiring A nonempty and leaves the metric on R unspecified
source_corrections.target_action: require A nonempty and identify the Euclidean metric d_E

source_corrections.evidence: explicit element-insertion allowance and pinned-schema validation pass; the construction requires x greater than zero
source_corrections.source_issue: the exercise uses R positive without defining whether zero is included
source_corrections.target_action: define R positive as the set of positive real numbers at first use

source_corrections.evidence: four explicit protected-math allowances pass and the surrounding prose fixes the Euclidean metric
source_corrections.source_issue: the opening example fixes the Euclidean metric d_E but alternates d and d_E for the resulting point-to-set distance
source_corrections.target_action: use d_E consistently in the three example displays

source_corrections.evidence: cumulative pinned PreTeXt 1.7.5 RelaxNG validation passes; five explicit whole-subtree topology-move allowances pass
source_corrections.source_issue: five theorem blocks reproduce the RelaxNG diagnostics; direct isolation proves the nested ordered and unordered lists are valid
source_corrections.source_locator: five authority theorem blocks embedded in exercise-level prose
source_corrections.target_action: retain the five complete theorem subtrees in source order in a permitted exercises-level introduction while preserving IDs mathematics and the exercise/task order

source_corrections.evidence: cumulative pinned-schema HTML build and strict XeLaTeX PDF build pass with both macros defined
source_corrections.source_issue: the source uses custom macros glb and lub that are not defined in the current cumulative wrapper
source_corrections.target_action: define lossless display macros for greatest and least upper bounds before strict PDF preflight
